metadata.label: omniston
metadata.description: STON.fi Omniston: RFQ/HTLC swap protocol. TON-side escrow contracts (shared by cross-chain and TON->TON orders) and resolver wallets tagged 'resolver'.

addresses.source: tonviewer/tonapi name 'Omniston Escrow Minter'; holds in-flight escrow funds of Omniston orders (HTLC cross-chain and TON->TON)

Omniston resolver, identified from public on-chain data: only depositor of destination-escrow payloads (forward_payload op 0xc0a5f0d9, 14-cell BoC) into the Escrow Minter; receives payouts of TON->X orders; Aug-Oct 2026 funding matches STON.fi's X->TON volume in dune.stonfi_protocol.dataset_omniston_daily_by_route within 1%. Resolver SBT 'Arbiter' exists in the 'Omniston resolvers' collection EQD23XiHeMH4XGNbLcGxYhIC6QfBL6uVFuyoaNihTSL0QX3I. Orders are funded/settled through the Omniston Escrow Minter EQAbWJ3Y1HgIIvcMq1prG1anlDC0T3cZlAU7luPT6LmTpmrZ.
addresses.comment: Omniston cross-chain resolver (Arbiter): funds TON destination escrows of X->TON HTLC orders

addresses.source: Omniston resolver, identified from public on-chain data: fills escrow orders with forward_payload op 0xd55df9d2 into the Escrow Minter, and the minter pays the trader and this wallet in the same trace; named as resolver inside user order payloads. Orders are funded/settled through the Omniston Escrow Minter EQAbWJ3Y1HgIIvcMq1prG1anlDC0T3cZlAU7luPT6LmTpmrZ.
addresses.comment: Omniston TON->TON resolver: fills on-TON escrow orders
